notes: Article τῆς before Ἰουδαίας is unrepresented because the ASV writes of Judaea with no determiner, so rule 21's determinerless clause keeps of with the name and rule 23 empties the article; a reference comparison reporting it as a disagreement is not a correction.

The verse-final saying is added under rule 37 as the English of MAT.3.2's λέγων, and MAT.3.2 leaves that token unrepresented with the matching note, so both sides of the versification difference say so.
τῇ takes a bare the before the substantival ἐρήμῳ, whose own English word glosses the lexeme, so rule 102 has no supplied nominal to hand the article.
